rules: Use Libre Baskerville ONLY for H1, H2, and featured article titles.
Use Inter for all UI elements, navigation, metadata, and body text.
Never center text by default. Left-align for readability.
Use tight tracking for large headings (-0.02em).

primary.name: Crimson Red
primary.usage: CTAs, Breaking News tags, Active states

grids.bento_news: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 md:gap-6 auto-rows-[minmax(200px,auto)]

containers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none md:rounded-lg overflow-hidden hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-[#D90429] text-white hover:bg-[#B90322] rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.news_card: group relative flex flex-col gap-3 bg-transparent
cards.dashboard_card: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Tetris' grid for the News Home page: Featured article spans 2 cols, 2 rows.
Use the 'Crimson Red' (#D90429) sparingly - only for CTAs and 'Breaking' tags.
Ensure the Dashboard Sidebar is dark (#111827) to distinguish it from the light content area.
Use 'Libre Baskerville' for all article headlines. Import it from Google Fonts.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Keep it flat and clean (Swiss Style).
For the Editor Dashboard, use Shadcn Table and Form components, but style them to be minimal (remove excess borders).
Mobile responsiveness is priority #1. Test the grid collapse behavior.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use glassmorphism for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
